DEF.name: James
DEF.note: Moved into the double pivot under Alonso's 3-4-2-1. Far lower sprint load than his wing-back role, which is what drove the hamstring history. Retains the captaincy; Gusto covers right-back. Caveat: still classed as a DEF, so ball recoveries do not count toward his DefCon threshold.

MID.name: Ødegaard
MID.note: Last season's 74-point total reflects 1,370 minutes, not form: he still finished joint-top for Arsenal PL assists (6). Started all 5 World Cup games with 4 assists, led the tournament in line-breaking passes, then scored and took player of the match in the Community Shield.
